# Evidence-Constrained Evaluation

## Abstract

This study evaluates a prespecified procedure using an independent held-out set. The median absolute error was 0.12 for n = 100 cases. The conclusion is limited to the evaluated conditions.

## Introduction

Evidence traceability requires claims to remain linked to inspected sources, defined methods, and frozen results [R2].

## Methods

The analysis used the frozen data release D1 and five repeated evaluations. Figure 1 reports the distribution of the prespecified error measure.

## Results

The median absolute error was 0.12 for n = 100 held-out cases. The bootstrap 95% confidence interval was 0.10 to 0.14 [R1].

## Discussion

The result supports the stated comparison under the evaluated conditions. Performance outside the observed range remains untested.

## Conclusion

The evaluated procedure reduced the prespecified error measure within the held-out cases.
